protocol: After freezing DESIRED_STATE and this role's config, but before the first substantive own-state/public semantic read, fetch ACTIVE_LEASE.json. If absent, create it with a unique invocation_token, base_latest_blob, acquired_at and expires_at. If present and status=active with expires_at in the future under a different token, do no substantive semantic work; write only an immutable role-local collision receipt if safe and leave LATEST unchanged. If released or expired, acquire only with update_file using the exact current lease blob SHA. A failed create/update CAS means another invocation won; re-read and obey the fresh lease. Refresh by CAS at least every 15 minutes during long work. Before updating LATEST, re-fetch LATEST and require that it still names the checkpoint/base blob expected by this invocation; otherwise write an immutable sibling checkpoint/certificate but do not move LATEST, and reconcile next invocation. Release ACTIVE_LEASE by CAS at normal termination. Lease expiry is crash recovery, not evidence that another live invocation is absent; if a heartbeat or same-token update is fresh, preserve it. Never read another role's coordination files.
reason: A prior same-role overlap forked from r98 and raced LATEST. This guard prevents duplicate semantic writers with one own-role CAS object while keeping stale-crash recovery bounded.
